game.title: Metro Exodus
game.blurb: Story-driven survival first-person shooter from 4A Games, released 2019-02-13. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Hidden milestones for the crew, the endings and a few story moments. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Summer, Taiga and the Dead City

chapters.title: Along the Way

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema has an empty game name; the store list confirms app 412020 ("Metro Exodus"). 10 of 68 Steam achievements are hidden; "Dodge master" (API name dlc_01_) was put with The Two Colonels, and the other nine sit in the main story chapter. Their API names include all_good and all_bad, and three of their display names (Duke, Damir, Alyosha) are also Fandom page names. Level chapters follow the level names in the achievement descriptions, in Steam list order (MOSCOW, VOLGA, YAMANTAU, CASPIAN, SUMMER, TAIGA, DEAD CITY); that order was not checked against the game. Where the vehicle and exploration achievements happen is not stated, so they have their own chapter. The two add-on chapters use the names in the descriptions (API names dlc_01_ and dlc_02_). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. metro.fandom.com has no page under "Metro Exodus"; metrovideogame.fandom.com answers the API with about 113 linked pages, including level pages such as "The Volga (Metro Exodus Level)" and "The Taiga (Metro Exodus Level)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
